title: A superseded statement must never be served as current
question: What is the Acme CRM monthly price for the Team plan?

expect.description: the superseding statement, not the superseded one

rationale: ADR-004/ADR-005: current-state reads must traverse SUPERSEDES/SUPERSEDED_BY chains; serving the stale value is a temporal-correctness failure even if it matches the newest recorded text verbatim.
